A '''raw rainbow fish''' is an item caught at level 38 [[Fishing]], granting 80 Fishing experience. A [[fly fishing rod]] and [[stripy feather]]s are required to catch them; if the player has unlocked the ability to fly fish without feathers from the [[Prawnbroker]], stripy feathers are not needed.

Any fly fishing spot can be used to catch raw rainbow fish. As salmon and trout can also be caught at fly fishing spots, the featherless fly fishing perk from the Pawnbroker additionally unlocks the ability to choose the type of fish you receive (changed under [[Settings#Construction|Construction options in Skills & Experience settings]]). Additionally, players may receive [[golden rainbow fish eggs]] while fishing, which can be placed into the [[Aquarium]].

Raw rainbow fish can be cooked on a [[range]] or a [[fire]] at level 35 [[Cooking]] to produce edible [[rainbow fish]]. The fish is used as bait for [[barb-tailed kebbit]]s in the [[Feldip Hunter area]], requiring level 33 [[Hunter]]. It may also be used to [[fishy mush|feed]] animals in the [[player-owned farm]], but this is not recommended, as there are cheaper fish to buy in bulk.
